description: Quantify the population attributable fraction and annual case burden of germline ATM heterozygosity
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Population impact of ATM heterozygosity, from values already established in this investigation
q      = 0.00199        # ATM P/LP allele frequency, gnomAD v4 (finding #2)
carrier= 2*q*(1-q)      # heterozygote frequency
RR     = {"Breast (female)":2.10,"Pancreas":4.21,"Prostate (aggressive)":2.58,"Ovary":1.57}
# annual US incident cases (SEER 2024 estimates, rounded)
CASES  = {"Breast (female)":310720,"Pancreas":66440,"Prostate (aggressive)":60000,"Ovary":19680}

rows=[]
for site,rr in RR.items():
    paf = carrier*(rr-1)/(1+carrier*(rr-1))        # population attributable fraction
    pcase = carrier*rr/(1+carrier*(rr-1))          # carrier prevalence among cases
    rows.append({"site":site,"RR":rr,
                 "carriers_among_cases_pct":100*pcase,
                 "PAF_pct":100*paf,
                 "US_cases_per_yr":CASES[site],
                 "ATM_carrier_cases_per_yr":round(CASES[site]*pcase),
                 "excess_cases_per_yr":round(CASES[site]*paf)})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(f"ATM heterozygote frequency: {carrier:.5f} (1 in {1/carrier:.0f})\n")
print(df.round(3).to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nTotal ATM-carrier cancer cases per year across these 4 sites: {df.ATM_carrier_cases_per_yr.sum():,}")
print(f"Total excess (attributable) cases per year: {df.excess_cases_per_yr.sum():,}")

# How many carriers exist, and how many ever develop breast cancer?
US_F = 168e6
ncarr_f = US_F*carrier
print(f"\nEstimated US female ATM P/LP carriers: {ncarr_f:,.0f}")
print(f"Of these, lifetime breast cancer (23.4%, finding #12): {ncarr_f*0.234:,.0f}")
print(f"Expected A-T births per year (US, 3.6M births, q^2): {3.6e6*q*q:,.0f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
x=np.arange(len(df)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2, df.carriers_among_cases_pct, w, color="#4878a8", label="ATM carriers among cases (%)")
ax.bar(x+w/2, df.PAF_pct, w, color="#c44e52", label="Population attributable fraction (%)")
ax.axhline(100*carrier, ls="--", c="k", lw=1)
ax.text(2.6, 100*carrier+0.03, f"carrier frequency in general population ({100*carrier:.2f}%)", fontsize=8, ha="right")
for i,(a,b,n) in enumerate(zip(df.carriers_among_cases_pct, df.PAF_pct, df.ATM_carrier_cases_per_yr)):
    ax.text(i-w/2, a+0.02, f"{a:.2f}%", ha="center", fontsize=8)
    ax.text(i+w/2, b+0.02, f"{b:.2f}%", ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(df.site, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("Percent")
ax.set_title("Population impact of germline ATM heterozygosity\ncarrier enrichment among cases and attributable fraction by site", fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=9); ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
